Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Terror

  • x3 Menace's current DMG to every BLEEDING enemy inside his range (including Air)
  • Ability can crit for x4.5 Menace's current DMG
  • Stuns Enemies for 2 seconds
  • 10 Seconds Stun Cooldown on enemies which have been affected by it.
  • 20 Seconds Ability Cooldown (No Global Cooldown)

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Menace's bleed damage is 30% of his damage
  • Menace has the ability to become a potential full AOE with his active ability if paired with a meta bleed unit, with Berserker (Rage) he can damage air enemies while having full aoe, but having Saka and Eccentric Researcher (Captain) have similar effects,
